description.value: Pallas Athena Greek Kouzina is a family-operated Greek restaurant in Port Coquitlam, BC, founded in 2006 and run by a mother-daughter team who prepare authentic homemade Greek cuisine fresh daily. The menu spans traditional mezes, seafood, and classic entrees including dolmathes, spanakopita, kalamari, and a range of salatas. Cyclists passing through the tri-city area will find a casual sit-down dining experience with a full menu and a catering service.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at pallasathena.org corroborates the OSM record as an active Greek restaurant at 1250 Dominion Ave, Port Coquitlam, and adds a suite number (101) and phone number (604.941.4871) not present in OSM tags. The website consistently spells the business name 'Kouzina' while OSM uses 'Kousina', a discrepancy flagged in concerns. No cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, water refill, or washroom access — are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, leaving all required criteria null.
concerns: Name spelling discrepancy: OSM uses 'Kousina' but the website consistently spells it 'Kouzina' across all pages.
Address discrepancy: OSM omits the suite number; the website lists the address as '101 – 1250 Dominion Ave', indicating the OSM address is incomplete.
Website copyright footer reads '© 2020', suggesting the site may not be actively maintained, though business content appears intact and OSM shows no closure indicators.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate sit-down restaurant well-placed to serve touring cyclists in the tri-city area, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking or visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from available evidence; on-site verification is needed before listing.
